name: Alexander Campos
description: Independent operator and builder. Makes small businesses modern by finding where they quietly lose money — unanswered inbound, late quotes, customers never followed up — and closing those gaps one system at a time. Six years running operations in regulated finance; builds the same way for a five-person business as for a $600M regulatory file exchange.

areaServed.primary: Northern Virginia, Washington DC metro, Richmond VA
areaServed.note: Local work in the NoVA / DC / Richmond corridor. Everything else async and remote.

audience.description: Owner-operated small businesses, roughly 1 to 50 employees, in trades and local services.

entryPoint.name: The Snapshot
entryPoint.description: Give a website URL, or describe the business. Returns a graded read across the eight parts of a business, the specific money leaks with estimated cost, off-site presence (reviews, search visibility, whether an AI assistant would recommend them), local competitors, and what to fix first. Requires a name and email to view the finished report.

framework.name: The eight parts of a business
framework.description: Every business is eight systems. Each can be measured, fixed, and handed back as an artifact the owner keeps.

parts.name: The front door
parts.question: Can people — and machines — find me?

parts.name: Intake
parts.question: What happens when someone tries to give me money at 9pm?

parts.name: Quoting & estimates
parts.question: Why does it take four days to send a number?

parts.name: Follow-up
parts.question: What happened to everyone who almost bought?

parts.name: Scheduling & dispatch
parts.question: Who is doing what, where, and does everyone know?

parts.name: Getting paid
parts.question: Why am I still chasing checks?

parts.name: Records & proof
parts.question: What happens when someone asks me to prove it?

parts.name: The owner's picture
parts.question: What is actually happening in my business right now?

offers.name: The Snapshot
offers.description: Free automated diagnostic. No call, no login. Graded across all eight parts, with leaks priced and a first move recommended.

offers.name: The Teardown
offers.description: A week of real analysis plus a 90-minute working session. Prioritized plan with costs attached, yours to execute with or without me. Credited against a later build.

offers.name: Fix One Thing
offers.description: One business part, built end to end, integrated, trained, handed over running. Fixed scope, fixed price, 30 days of adjustments included.

offers.name: The Modern Build
offers.description: Front door, intake, quoting and follow-up built as one connected system with a single customer record. Weekly demos, full training, 90 days of support.

offers.name: Operator
offers.description: Maintenance, monitoring, a monthly operating picture, and standing build hours. No annual contract, no termination fee.

differentiators: Operator first, not an agency. Six years running regulated finance operations where a missed handoff is an audit finding.
Fixed scope and fixed price agreed before work starts; overruns are absorbed, not billed.
Client owns every account, domain, and repository from day one. Nothing is held hostage.
Will recommend off-the-shelf software over custom work when that is the honest answer.
One person builds and delivers it. No account manager, no handoff.
Provenance by default — every number in a deliverable carries where it came from, or is marked unknown.

credentials.current: Senior Process Manager, Card Legal Recoveries Operations, Capital One
highlights: Built monitoring for a $600M+ regulatory file exchange network handling 300+ daily transmissions; reduced manual monitoring by 78%
Zero transmission errors during a $35B merger integration
Resolved a 20,000+ account logic failure and documented the failure taxonomy
credentials.priorExperience: Five years at Apple Federal Credit Union — teller to branch manager to enterprise support across 25 branches

products.name: Reframed
products.description: Resume analysis that preserves the writer's voice. Multi-provider model routing, Stripe billing, Neon Postgres.

products.name: ForgeFrame
products.description: Persistent memory for agents. MCP-native, SQLite + FTS5, strength decay, constitutional memories that never decay.

freeTools.name: AI Visibility Check
freeTools.description: Asks an AI assistant to recommend businesses in a given trade and town, and reports whether the named business appears. Only about 1 in 100 local businesses is ever named. Takes about ten seconds.

freeTools.name: The Small Business Web Index
freeTools.description: Aggregate anonymized research across every Snapshot run: which parts of a small business are usually broken, by trade, and the estimated annual cost. No individual business is identifiable; categories below a minimum sample size are withheld.
